name: Tool Provenance Verification
description: Verifies tool registration, approval, version, and description integrity before every invocation.
threat_addressed: A tool whose description has been modified after approval (semantic supply chain attack) can redirect agent behavior without any code-level vulnerability being exploited. The agent follows the tampered description, believing it is still invoking the same approved tool.
enforcement_mechanism: Before every tool invocation, provenance is verified: the tool is registered, approved, version-matched, and its description hash matches the audited baseline. Mismatches block invocation and trigger an alert.

security_outcome.pass: Provenance verified per invocation. Unregistered tools blocked. Hash mismatches trigger block and alert.
security_outcome.fail: Unregistered tool, unapproved tool (observed only), hash mismatch, or version mismatch detected.

display_detail: Verifies tool registration, approval status, version, and description integrity before every invocation.
remediation_hint_template: Tool provenance verification failed. The tool may be unregistered, unapproved (observed only), or its description may have changed since approval. Approve the tool with: ancilis approve-tool {tool_name}
